pricing: PAY_PER_EVENT; one event "Result" (each result written to the dataset); BRONZE 0.0023 USD, FREE 0.0027; account tier BRONZE per fetch-actor-details
only_posts_newer_than: Input doc says "Limit how far back to scrape" and "Pinned posts may still appear even with this filter set". Billing is per result written to the dataset, so filtered-out posts are not billed if dropped before write. Whether older posts are fetched internally before being dropped is UNCONFIRMED (docs do not say).
max_total_charge: Supported: platform docs (docs.apify.com pay-per-event) say users "won't be billed beyond the limit" and the actor receives ACTOR_MAX_TOTAL_CHARGE_USD. Enforcement by the platform is documented; it will be verified against the first run's charged total before the next run starts. Not tested to the limit beforehand.
partial_results: Items pushed to the dataset before the cap stay and are billed; no mid-account resume. A run that hits its cap marks all accounts in that run incomplete unless per-account rule (oldest post before window start, or fewer than 200 results) says complete.
budget: 5 runs x 10 accounts, maxTotalChargeUsd 1.0 each (max 5.0 total), sequential; resultsLimit 200, resultsType posts, onlyPostsNewerThan 2026-07-17, directUrls profile URLs. Worst case uncapped 50x200x0.0023 = 23 USD.
